result.reason: Current first-party Uattzy FAQ explicitly says the tariff is displayed for each connector before charging and that prices can vary by delivered power, session duration and stall occupation time. Therefore the July 2026 Quick/Fast public tariff announcement cannot safely be promoted as a deterministic network-wide or class-wide tariff for every IT*ESH/IT*GAS EVSE without connector-level confirmation.
result.tariffChannel: direct Uattzy app/RFID; QR rollout and POS on enabled stations; roaming eMSP strictly separate
result.preauthorization: 15 EUR on some stations when using Uattzy app; temporary bank pre-authorization, not a tariff component
result.blockingCondition: For each current IT*ESH / IT*GAS connector, obtain a deterministic connector -> current Uattzy direct price mapping from app/guest/QR/POS/backend payload. Only then promote that connector as rankable.
negativePaths: Do not apply 0.57/0.67 EUR/kWh globally to all Uattzy-lineage EVSE.
Do not apply 0.61/0.72 EUR/kWh POS prices to stations without proof POS is enabled and the connector belongs to the announced tariff scope.
Do not treat third-party roaming prices as direct CPO prices.
